articles.summary: FrontView REIT, Inc. (NYSE: FVR) (the “Company”, “FrontView”, “we”, “our”, or “us”), today announced that Fitch Ratings (“Fitch”) has assigned the Company a BBB- investment-grade rating with a stable outlook. “Achieving an investment-grade rating from Fitch represents a significant milestone for FrontView, particularly as the smallest publicly traded REIT by market capitalization to earn this distinction, just over two years after our IPO,” said Pierre Revol, President and Chief Financial Officer of FrontView REIT. “This rating reflects the quality of our underlying real estate, the strength and diversification of our portfolio, and the disciplined execution of our strategy. Our real estate-first approach, focused on owning high-quality properties in desirable locations, supports attractive cash flows and has delivered sector-leading rent recapture rates while providing meaningful downside protection.
